COMPOSITION
The markdown contains 9 sections (intro + 8 H2s) whereas the blueprint has 7 slots, requiring section reuse and omission of non-applicable slots (testimonial is omitted as no quotes exist). The visual rhythm flows from dark Hero through neutral and light informational blocks, alternating between content-image (with mirroring) and structured banner/features to keep reader engagement high.
